ops.title: query_graph observers shipped: cc-transcript 14.41.0, Captain Hook 12.93.4 (2026-10-13)
ops.body:
Where the observer change lives, for anyone tracing a version:

- Producer: yasyf/cc-transcript#55, squash d4fb22525aee69769fc4c41db5f4e9960fb7a437, tag v14.41.0, on PyPI since 2026-10-13T07:45Z. Design and semantics are in note a881eec.
- Consumer: yasyf/captain-hook#361, squash 8b0b5269401bf76e6e10417a8c4bc80ca07d3ecc, released by Autobump as 12.93.4, which requires `cc-transcript[judge]==14.41.0`.
- 14.40.1 and earlier reject `observers` with `invalid_request`; a consumer must pin 14.41.0 or later before it sends the key.

Decisions taken during delivery:

- One release per merged PR, as this repo already does. v14.41.0 carries observers alone. Lane D's `prepared_fact_producer` (PR #56) gets v14.42.0, and its Captain Hook change moves the pin again and re-vendors `config.schema.json`.
- Captain Hook CI checks every vendored schema against the pinned package, so a pin bump and the schema regeneration for that release always land in one commit.
- CI was the first compile of the change and passed with no fix round. The Rust core suite ran only with `--no-default-features`; backlog task bb29713 tracks the default-feature gap.

Not measured: live IO saved on a host. The owner has no counter for observed queries. The only number is from a two-file fixture on the installed 12.93.4 build: four deep conditions cost 4 `query_graph` requests alone and 1 with observers.
